ui.agents.upload.action.edit_agent: Closes the dialog and opens the agent's editor, for the issues a name change cannot fix.
ui.agents.upload.action.open_listing: primary button label after a successful publish
Navigates to the new hub listing. Only shown when the outcome carries a hub id.

ui.agents.upload.action.publish.length_hint: One word; it sits alone in the dialog footer, which keeps its width across the three submit states.
ui.agents.upload.action.publish.note: The submit control for a FIRST publication. It must not promise an update: the branch that replaces an existing listing has its own label (action.update_listing), because a label promising a first publication on an update press is the same defect as the reverse.

ui.agents.upload.action.publishing.role: primary button label while the publication request is in flight
ui.agents.upload.action.publishing.length_hint: One word plus a single-character ellipsis (U+2026).
ui.agents.upload.action.publishing.note: U+2026, never three periods. The button is disabled in this state, so this label is the only thing on it that still changes.

ui.agents.upload.action.update_listing.role: primary button label when the press will UPDATE an existing public listing
ui.agents.upload.action.update_listing.length_hint: Two words; keep it short enough not to outgrow the footer.
ui.agents.upload.action.update_listing.note: Says update, not publish. The press sends an existing listing id, so a label reading as a first publication would be the receipt's own defect one control earlier.

ui.agents.upload.availability.agent_labe: prefix before the agent name in the name-check line
Names which agent the availability line is about. The name beside it is data; the colon and space belong to this message.
ui.agents.upload.availability.checking: status line under the name field
The availability route is being asked. U+2026 rather than three periods.
ui.agents.upload.availability.free: status line under the name field
'Looks free', not 'is free': reservations are not consulted, so the submit answer is authoritative. Do not strengthen this claim in translation.

ui.agents.upload.availability.reserved_n.role: status line under the name field, when the hub holds the typed name as one of its built-in agents
ui.agents.upload.availability.reserved_n.length_hint: One line under the field (about 60 characters in English).

placeholders.name: The built-in agent's canonical spelling as the hub reports it; typeable backwards into the field, so never translated or re-cased. The quote marks around it belong to the message and are the locale's own.

ui.agents.upload.availability.reserved_n.note: The named variant: it hands the author the spelling the reservation actually holds, which is the only help this line can give them. The refusal itself is the alert above, not this sentence.

ui.agents.upload.availability.reserved_u.role: status line under the name field, when a built-in holds the name but the check returned no spelling for it
ui.agents.upload.availability.reserved_u.length_hint: One line under the field (about 55 characters in English).
ui.agents.upload.availability.reserved_u.note: The variant without a canonical spelling. It must not promise the name is free or say which built-in holds it, because this state knows neither.

ui.agents.upload.availability.taken: status line under the name field
The name is already published. The remedy is editing the field above, not a control of its own.
ui.agents.upload.error.cannot_publish: alert title in the publish form
Validation issues below stop the submit; each issue is its own list item.
ui.agents.upload.field.name_hint: The separators the hub refuses and the length cap. Quotes are typographic in English; keep the characters the rule is about intact in every locale.
ui.agents.upload.field.name_label: The name this agent will carry on the public hub, which may differ from its local name.

ui.agents.upload.intro.org.role: sentence introducing the 'what is published' list, organization destination
ui.agents.upload.intro.org.length_hint: Two to three lines above the list; the organization name is data and can be long.

placeholders.destination: The organization's display name, data returned by the backend; never translate it.

ui.agents.upload.intro.org.note: The organization variant of intro.public. The trailing colon introduces the list below it and belongs to this message, not to the list. 'Instruction set' is what a publication IS: the sentence must not start describing conversation, history or memory.

ui.agents.upload.intro.public.role: sentence introducing the 'what is published' list, public hub destination
ui.agents.upload.intro.public.length_hint: Two lines above the list (about 130 characters in English).
ui.agents.upload.intro.public.note: The public twin of intro.org. 'Agent Hub' is the surface's shipped name; render it the same way this language renders ui.hub.pages.header.title, not as a second name. The trailing colon belongs to this message.

ui.agents.upload.list.instructions: list item in the publish summary
Second of three things that leave the machine.
ui.agents.upload.list.name: list item in the publish summary
plain, factual
First of three things that leave the machine when publishing.
ui.agents.upload.list.surface: list item in the publish summary
Third of three: the tool surface, effort tier and delegation, shown only when present.

ui.agents.upload.not_leaving.org.role: sentence after the 'what is published' list, organization destination
ui.agents.upload.not_leaving.org.length_hint: Three to four lines: the longest sentence in the dialog, and the one an author reads before deciding.

placeholders.destination: The organization's display name, data returned by the backend; never translate it. The possessive after it is English grammar, and the construction is yours to render natively.

ui.agents.upload.not_leaving.org.note: The PRE-submit promise, not the receipt: sign_in.nothing_left is its past-tense sibling with a shorter list, so do not merge the two. Every item named here is something the backend strips from a published archive - do not add, drop or reorder one, and do not turn the sentence into a warning.

ui.agents.upload.not_leaving.public.role: sentence after the 'what is published' list, public hub destination
ui.agents.upload.not_leaving.public.note: The public twin of not_leaving.org. 'Anyone' is the whole audience of the public hub, so it must not be narrowed to members, to readers of a link or to signed-in accounts.

ui.agents.upload.published.listed: {name} is the hub display name (escaped display bytes, never translated). Quotes around it are part of the message; the sentence says anyone may read and install it.

ui.agents.upload.published.org_listed.role: receipt body after an organization publication succeeded
ui.agents.upload.published.org_listed.length_hint: Two to three lines in the result region; the agent name and the organization name are both data.

placeholders.name: The agent's name as stored; user-authored data, never translate it. Keep it quoted with the locale's own quotation marks.
placeholders.destination: The organization's display name, data returned by the backend; never translate it. The possessive after it is English grammar.

ui.agents.upload.published.org_listed.note: The organization twin of published.listed, and it must not imply the public hub: what was published is readable by that organization's members only.

ui.agents.upload.published.republished: success alert body after an update
{name} is the hub display name. Says the hub now holds the current instruction set, which is what distinguishes this from a first publish.

ui.agents.upload.receipt.title_hub.role: heading of the receipt alert, public publication with no prior listing
ui.agents.upload.receipt.title_hub.length_hint: One short line in the alert heading (about 20 characters in English).
ui.agents.upload.receipt.title_hub.note: Names no agent: the body beside it does. Uses the short 'hub' the shipped English carries rather than expanding it to 'Agent Hub'. Not the dialog title (title.published_public) - that one names the agent and asks nothing either.

ui.agents.upload.receipt.title_org.role: heading of the receipt alert, organization publication
ui.agents.upload.receipt.title_org.length_hint: One short line; the organization name is data and can be long.

placeholders.destination: The organization's display name, data returned by the backend; never translate it.

ui.agents.upload.receipt.title_org.note: Names the destination because an organization publication is the case where the audience is not obvious from the screen.

ui.agents.upload.receipt.title_updated.role: heading of the receipt alert, an existing public listing was replaced
ui.agents.upload.receipt.title_updated.note: The UPDATE receipt: the hub replaced a listing that already existed. It must not read as a first publication, and it pairs with published.republished rather than published.listed.

ui.agents.upload.sign_in.needed: Publishing needs a Radient credential. Radient and 'Agent hub' are product names and stay English.
ui.agents.upload.sign_in.nothing_left: Enumerates what does NOT leave the machine, so a publisher can judge the disclosure. Long sentence; wraps in the alert.
ui.agents.upload.sign_in.reauthenticate: notice when the hub refuses the credential
Says what to do (sign in again) and why (replace the refused credential). The sign-in control sits under it.

ui.agents.upload.target.blocked_hint.role: hint under the publish-target picker when at least one organization is blocked by its plan
ui.agents.upload.target.blocked_hint.tone: plain, explanatory; a plan state, not a refusal of the reader
ui.agents.upload.target.blocked_hint.length_hint: Two lines under the picker (about 150 characters in English): the longest hint in the dialog.

placeholders.count: How many blocked organizations the picker is showing. It selects the organization phrase; it never renders as a digit.
placeholders.org: One organization's display name, or the shipped placeholder 'this organization' (ui.hub.pages.scope.org_unnamed) when the app has no name for it; never translate the name.

ui.agents.upload.target.blocked_hint.plural_guidance: Use the target locale's own CLDR categories for the blocked count. The 'one' arm names the organization the reader has to ask; every other category says 'any of the organizations marked above', without naming one, and must stay usable for a count of two as well as a dozen.
ui.agents.upload.target.blocked_hint.note: 'Team plan' is the product tier's name and stays recognisable; 'Radient console' names where an owner activates it. A blocked organization is shown DISABLED rather than hidden, so this hint explains a control that is visible and unusable.

ui.agents.upload.target.label: field label for the destination group
plain
Introduces the public hub and organization targets below it.
ui.agents.upload.target.orgs_unread: hint when memberships could not be read
Explains the degraded destination: public only. The retry is the reader's next action, so it is named without a control of its own.
ui.agents.upload.target.upgrade: inline suffix on a disabled organization target
A blocked organization stays visible with this hint rather than disappearing, so a lapsed plan reads as a plan state, not an absence.

ui.agents.upload.target.visibility_hint_.role: hint under the publish-target picker when every visible target is available
ui.agents.upload.target.visibility_hint_.length_hint: Two lines under the picker (about 130 characters in English).
ui.agents.upload.target.visibility_hint_.note: Explains the two audiences the picker chooses between: a public hub publication is readable by anyone, an organization's agents only by that organization's members. Do not swap the halves or widen 'agents' to 'content'.

ui.agents.upload.terms.lead: first fragment of the consent sentence, before the link
Flows directly into a link whose text is terms.link, then terms.tail. A trailing space is supplied by the caller; do not add one.
ui.agents.upload.terms.link: link text inside the consent sentence
Links to the public terms page. Must read as the object of 'agree to the' in the lead fragment.
ui.agents.upload.terms.tail: last fragment of the consent sentence, after the link
Completes the sentence begun by terms.lead and the linked terms.link. Must begin where the link leaves off.

ui.agents.upload.title.publish_org.role: Publish dialog title, before the decision, organization destination
ui.agents.upload.title.publish_org.length_hint: One line in the dialog header; the organization name is data and can be long.

placeholders.name: The agent's name as stored; user-authored data, never translate it.
placeholders.destination: The organization's display name, data returned by the backend; never translate it.

ui.agents.upload.title.publish_org.note: The organization variant of publish_public: the destination is named, so this is about a private publication rather than the public hub.

ui.agents.upload.title.publish_public.role: Publish dialog title, before the decision, public hub destination
ui.agents.upload.title.publish_public.length_hint: One line in the dialog header (about 60 characters in English); it wraps under the close control, so keep the name visible.

placeholders.name: The agent's name as stored, user-authored data; never translate it. Keep it quoted with the locale's own quotation marks.

ui.agents.upload.title.publish_public.note: 'Agent Hub' is the surface's shipped name; render it the same way this language renders ui.hub.pages.header.title (the hub's own page title), not as a second name.

ui.agents.upload.title.published_org.role: Publish dialog title after the hub accepted an organization publication
ui.agents.upload.title.published_org.length_hint: One line in the dialog header; the organization name is data.

placeholders.name: The agent's name as stored; user-authored data, never translate it.
placeholders.destination: The organization's display name, data returned by the backend; never translate it.

ui.agents.upload.title.published_org.note: Receipt sibling of publish_org; no question mark, and it must not imply the public hub.

ui.agents.upload.title.published_public.role: Publish dialog title after the hub accepted a public publication
ui.agents.upload.title.published_public.length_hint: One line in the dialog header; about 45 characters in English.

placeholders.name: The agent's name as stored; user-authored data, never translate it.

ui.agents.upload.title.published_public.note: A receipt is not a question: no question mark, and do not reuse the imperative publish_public string.

ui.agents.upload.title.republished.role: Publish dialog title after an existing public listing was updated
ui.agents.upload.title.republished.length_hint: One line in the dialog header; about 55 characters in English.

placeholders.name: The agent's name as stored; user-authored data, never translate it.

ui.agents.upload.title.republished.note: The UPDATE receipt: it must say the listing was updated, not created, and must not read as a fresh publication.

ui.agents.upload.title.update_listing.role: Publish dialog title when an existing hub listing will be updated
ui.agents.upload.title.update_listing.length_hint: One line in the dialog header; about 50 characters in English.

placeholders.name: The agent's name as stored; user-authored data, never translate it.

ui.agents.upload.title.update_listing.note: It must say UPDATE, not publish: the dialog would otherwise read as a first publication of something already on the hub.

ui.agents.upload.sign_in.title_continue.role: Heading of the sign-in block in the publish dialog (signed-out state)
ui.agents.upload.sign_in.title_continue.note: Heads the Radient sign-in buttons shown before an agent can be published.

ui.agents.upload.sign_in.title_again.role: Heading of the sign-in block in the publish dialog (expired session)
ui.agents.upload.sign_in.title_again.note: Heads the Radient sign-in buttons when the stored session was refused.
